std::sort

template< class RandomIt > void sort( RandomIt first, RandomIt last );(1)
template< class RandomIt, class Compare > void sort( RandomIt first, RandomIt last, Compare comp );(2)

Sorts the elements in the target range [first, last). The order of equivalent elements is not guaranteed to be preserved.

Parameters

first, last define the target range; comp orders the elements.

Complexity

O(N log N) comparisons.
